captions.instagram:
Nov 15 missed: Water Board now plans 40 MGD Godavari trial run

HMWSSB is preparing a trial run to divert an extra 40 MGD of Godavari water from Mallannasagar to the Ghanpur Master Balancing Reservoir. The Nov 15 target slipped after crews hit heavy rock along a 150 m forest stretch; officials set a two-day deadline on Nov 20 to finish the interconnection.

Why it matters: El Nino conditions are draining the Singur and Manjira reservoirs.

Source: Telangana Today. Image: Telangana Today
